name: afterglow-themes
description: Liminal HQ Afterglow: colour themes for the OpenCode terminal UI, VS Code, Midnight Commander, Claude Code, Codex, bat and delta, Firefox and Chrome and Edge
author: Liminal HQ, Scott Morris

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-vscode.mjs && node scripts/build-mc.mjs && node scripts/build-claude.mjs && node scripts/build-tmtheme.mjs && node scripts/build-firefox.mjs && node scripts/build-chromium.mjs
scripts.validate:themes: node scripts/validate-themes.mjs && node scripts/validate-vscode.mjs && node scripts/validate-mc.mjs && node scripts/validate-claude.mjs && node scripts/validate-tmtheme.mjs
scripts.check:themes: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- themes vscode/themes mc/skins claude/themes tmtheme firefox/themes chromium/themes
scripts.validate: bun run format:check && bun run check:headers && bun run lint:md && bun run test && bun run build && bun run validate:themes
